description: This file defines the ApiClient class for setting up Retrofit/OkHttp clients with mock and authentication interceptors, mainly for testing or demo purposes in an Android app.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A singleton class that provides a configured Retrofit API client with mock backend and authentication interceptors.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Constructs and returns an ApiClient instance with dependencies and interceptors set up, including mock backend, auth header, and token refresh logic.

methods.name: loggingInterceptor
methods.description: Creates and returns an HttpLoggingInterceptor configured to log request and response details at the BODY level.
